services.desc: There is a 2 night minimum stay required for all cabin and cottage rentals. If a 1 night exception is made - additional housekeeping fees will apply. Cottage #1 is 16 x 24 with an 8 ft. front porch, 1 double bed, 2 sets of bunk beds, and a loveseat. Cottage #3 is 13 x 32, with an 8 ft. front porch, 1 full size bed, a folding futon, and 1 set of bunk beds. Each Cottage also includes air conditioning and heat, bathroom w/ shower, kitchenette with medium size refrigerator, 2-burner cooktop stove, microwave, sink, toaster, and coffee maker. blurb: Pinch Pond Family Campground & RV Park has been family owned and operated for over 40 years! Located in the foothills of northern Lancaster County, halfway between Hershey and Pennsylvania Dutch Country, Pinch Pond offers you the perfect combination of camping fun and the convenience of touring.
